# openwebui_model (Data Source)

Looks up an existing model by its `model_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openwebui_model" "llama" {
  model_id = "llama3.2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_id` (String) Identifier of the model to look up.

### Read-Only

- `base_model_id` (String) Identifier of the underlying base model.
- `capabilities` (Attributes) Feature capability flags returned by Open WebUI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the model was created.
- `default_feature_ids` (List of String) List of feature IDs enabled by default.
- `description` (String) Short description shown alongside the model name.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier mirroring `model_id`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the model is visible and available to users.
- `meta_additional_json` (String) Additional metadata JSON as returned by Open WebUI.
- `name` (String) Display name of the model.
- `params` (Attributes) Model parameter values returned by Open WebUI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params))
- `params_additional_json` (String) Additional parameters JSON as returned by Open WebUI.
- `profile_image_url` (String) URL of the model's profile image.
- `read_groups` (List of String) Read-access group names.
- `suggestion_prompts` (List of String) List of suggested starter prompts shown when the model is selected.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags for categorising the model.
- `tool_ids` (List of String) List of tool IDs attached to the model by default.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the model was last updated.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user identifier.
- `write_groups` (List of String) Write-access group names.

<a id="nestedatt--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `citations` (Boolean) Whether the model returns citations.
- `code_interpreter` (Boolean) Whether code interpreter is available.
- `file_upload` (Boolean) Whether file uploads are allowed in chat.
- `image_generation` (Boolean) Whether image generation is available.
- `status_updates` (Boolean) Whether the model emits status update messages.
- `usage` (Boolean) Whether token usage statistics are returned.
- `vision` (Boolean) Whether the model accepts image inputs.
- `web_search` (Boolean) Whether web search is available.


<a id="nestedatt--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params`

Read-Only:

- `custom_params` (Map of String) Additional key/value parameters returned by Open WebUI.
- `format` (String) Output format, e.g. `json`.
- `frequency_penalty` (Number) Penalty scaled by token frequency.
- `function_calling` (String) Function calling mode, e.g. `"auto"`.
- `keep_alive` (String) How long to keep the model loaded in memory, e.g. `"5m"`.
- `max_tokens` (Number) Maximum number of tokens to generate.
- `min_p` (Number) Minimum probability threshold for token sampling.
- `mirostat` (Number) Mirostat sampling mode: 0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat, 2 = Mirostat 2.0.
- `mirostat_eta` (Number) Mirostat learning rate.
- `mirostat_tau` (Number) Mirostat target entropy.
- `num_batch` (Number) Batch size for prompt processing.
- `num_ctx` (Number) Context window size in tokens.
- `num_gpu` (Number) Number of GPU layers to use.
- `num_keep` (Number) Number of tokens to retain from the previous context.
- `num_thread` (Number) Number of CPU threads to use for inference.
- `presence_penalty` (Number) Penalty for tokens that have appeared at all.
- `reasoning_effort` (String) Reasoning effort level for models that support it, e.g. `"high"`.
- `reasoning_tags` (List of String) List of XML tags used to delimit reasoning tokens.
- `repeat_last_n` (Number) Number of tokens to look back for repeat penalty.
- `repeat_penalty` (Number) Penalty applied to repeated tokens.
- `seed` (Number) Random seed for reproducible outputs.
- `stream_delta_chunk_size` (Number) Chunk size in tokens for streaming responses.
- `stream_response` (Boolean) Whether to stream the response. Defaults to the base model setting.
- `system` (String) System prompt prepended to every conversation.
- `temperature` (Number) Sampling temperature (0–2). Lower values are more deterministic.
- `tfs_z` (Number) Tail free sampling z parameter.
- `think` (Boolean) Whether to enable chain-of-thought reasoning.
- `top_k` (Number) Top-k sampling: number of highest-probability tokens to consider.
- `top_p` (Number) Nucleus sampling probability threshold.
- `use_mlock` (Boolean) Whether to lock model weights in RAM.
- `use_mmap` (Boolean) Whether to use memory-mapped files for model weights.
